name: @mcptoolshop/housekeeping
description: Operational-health warehouse for a GitHub organization: CI, issues, PRs, releases, Actions cost and repo hygiene, collected into SQLite and audited against written rules.

scripts.rebuild: node -e "for (const x of ['','-wal','-shm']) require('fs').rmSync('data/housekeeping.db'+x,{force:true})" && node src/cli.mjs load && node src/cli.mjs report
